text: Long ago, in a ramshackle shed deep in a Malaysian forest, a widowed mother and her children Along and Angah [take in a strange little girl|trigger|an outsider reaches in] who follows them home. By morning she is eating raw birds, and before slitting her own throat she tells them [they will all be dead by the next full moon|rules|death on a deadline]. Stones appear around the house, an old woman called Tok offers rituals with white pigeons, and a hunter comes searching through [the dark trees|images|wild and lonely places].
